top_fixes.title: Forward-price series frozen at 2026-05-17 starves backtest stack
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Root-cause pull-historical-prices stall after 05-17 and backfill; add freshness assertion (max price date < today-3bd -> ::error:: + skip/fail) at top of walk-forward-perf.js and method-effectiveness.js

top_fixes.title: Monthly SEC XBRL workflow output consumed/stored by nothing
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Disable the workflow until a snapshot-merge consumer exists, or build+persist the consumer via actions/cache or a data branch

top_fixes.title: SPY/QQQ/IWM benchmark series nearly empty; canonical dates anchored to 3-point SPY
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Backfill >=120d SPY/QQQ/IWM in pull-historical-prices; assert benchmark series length >= horizon+buffer before anchoring canonical dates, else per-ticker fallback + flag

top_fixes.title: Worker count and yf queue concurrency coupled to one env
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Introduce separate YF_QUEUE_CONCURRENCY (or set yf queue.concurrency = CONCURRENCY) and make the worker-pool sleep the single rate governor

top_fixes.title: Tail throttle gates on shared idx not myIdx
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Drop the `idx < stocks.length` guard and sleep unconditionally (next iteration breaks on myIdx>=length), or gate on `myIdx + concurrency < stocks.length`

top_fixes.title: FTS retry ignores 429; throttle on FTS leg fails ticker
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Add 429/rate-limit detection to the FTS retry condition with the same backoff ladder as quoteSummaryWithRetry; attach a no-op .catch to the aborted underlying promise

top_fixes.title: Staleness rotation + price-only fast-path are no-ops in CI
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Persist a committed compact per-ticker lastPulled index (or actions/cache for fundamentals-cache keyed by week), restore before pull so rotation+price-only engage; re-validate the 13% gate

top_fixes.title: Repo bloat: ~125MB churned/run, state blobs nearing 100MB block
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Shard/gzip method-history-state.json + alert-state off main (or gitignore + actions/cache), write methods-history vintages to gitignored ndjson/data branch, add a size gate after Archive (fail if any state file > 80MB or methods-history count > 95)

top_fixes.title: Manual-dispatch race produces unresolvable rebase/cherry-pick conflict (also F-SM-002)
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Share the 'main-push' concurrency group for workflow_dispatch too, or gate the manual Commit step on a lock check, or shard state files so conflicts are disjoint

top_fixes.title: Single end-of-job commit loses whole run on timeout (~19% of days)
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Add an intermediate Commit Pull Data step after Verify Pull Coverage, or move the report chain into a separate job with artifact handoff so the pull commit is not hostage to report runtime

top_fixes.title: FTS is sole fundamentals source with no backstop
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Add a per-run sentinel counting tickers with non-empty annual.annualRev post-merge; assert it stays above a floor (>80% of attempted) and fail/alert on collapse

top_fixes.title: targetMeanPrice/targetMedianPrice scaled by financial FX factor not trading factor
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Route targetMeanPrice/targetMedianPrice through scaleTrading() (tradingFactor) instead of scale(), mirroring marketCap

top_fixes.title: methods-history vintages (~26MB) approach GitHub 50MB push-reject limit
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Write vintages gzipped (.json.gz, ~10x), and/or add a pre-push hard-fail size guard when any vintage > 45MB; lower --methods-keep-days

top_fixes.title: earnings-stability scores 0.99 when failing on positive-years (maxDecline=0)
top_fixes.suggested_fix: In normalizeMethodScore require val>0 before the 0.99 lte shortcut (fall through to generic curve otherwise), or have earnings-stability export a composite pass-distance as value

top_fixes.title: Ignores HORIZON_DAYS, measures full available history span
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Snap start to series entry nearest (endDate - HORIZON_DAYS) via nearestTradingDay, or delete in favor of walk-forward-perf.js

top_fixes.title: Min-vintage gate applied only to alphaVsUniverse, not benchmark/frozen
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Apply the same MIN_VINTAGES gate (counting non-null contributing vintages) to medianAlphaVsBenchmark and medianAlphaVsFrozenVintage; emit a *Note when gated

top_fixes.title: Overlapping daily vintages resampled as i.i.d. inflates significance
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Use non-overlapping vintages per horizon or a block/cluster bootstrap that resamples whole vintages with within-vintage ticker dedup; report effective sample size

top_fixes.title: ~300 simultaneous CI tests, no FWER/FDR control
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Apply BH-FDR or Bonferroni across the full grid of CIs before labeling significance; require persistence across consecutive reports for promotion

top_fixes.title: Per-method filter+sort of full universe run 3x
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Pre-extract a flat numeric column per metric once (row._lb[metricId]), sort plain {ticker,val} tuples; bucket per-method valid lists in a single forward pass

top_fixes.title: main() recomputes eligibleForMode + topAllMust per mode just to log counts
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Have buildHtml return (or stash) the per-mode eligible + all-MUST-pass counts it already computed and log those instead of recomputing

top_fixes.title: FTS field-name lists are exact-string guesses; rename yields silent null
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Emit a per-run FTS field-coverage report (% non-null per logical field) into the manifest; gate on a sharp drop for any previously well-populated field

top_fixes.title: Schema-validation errors classified as not-found -> mark live intl tickers delisted
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Give schema-validation its own errClass ('schema-reject') that does NOT set meta.delisted; add a CI gate that fails when schema-reject count exceeds a threshold or concentrates in one region

top_fixes.title: Manifest flush cadence on per-worker myIdx; SIGKILL undercounts n_ok
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Drive cadence off a shared processed counter (`if (++done % 100 === 0)`); trap SIGTERM to flush the manifest once before exit

top_fixes.title: FX_TO_USD seeded verbatim casing but read uppercased; stale-revert gap
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Build FX_TO_USD by iterating raw.rates and assigning FX_TO_USD[k.toUpperCase()]=rate (never Object.assign of raw verbatim); assert all keys uppercase after load

top_fixes.title: Screener/exchange sweep fully sequential and untimed (hang risk)
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Wrap fetchScreener/fetchExchangePage in a per-call timeout (race a setTimeout reject) and parallelize the region x bucket sweep with a bounded worker pool (4-6), keeping the sleep as rate governor

top_fixes.title: price-only floor skips when quote omits marketCap; decayed names linger
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Mirror the full-pull rule: in price-only, if q.marketCap is null for USD-trading tickers force a full pull or mark the stale mcap untrusted for next-cycle re-evaluation

top_fixes.title: Corrupt methodHistory sidecar silently resets to {} (no backup, no fail)
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Mirror the alert-state guard in _loadMethodHistory: on parse failure copy to method-history-state.json.corrupt.<ts> and exit non-zero (gated by RESET env) / refuse to overwrite this run

top_fixes.title: methodHistory sidecar pruned one run later than methodState; cleanup swallows errors
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Apply the live-methodState-ticker filter inside _saveMethodHistory at write time so the two committed files never diverge and orphan cleanup isn't dependent on a successful next run

top_fixes.title: fcf-yield uses sector median as pass gate (no positive-only guard)
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Clamp eff.threshold to >= the static 0.05 floor for fcf-yield, or add fcf-yield to POSITIVE_ONLY_METRICS and use p75 rather than the median for the pass gate

top_fixes.title: fcf-yield median built from raw FCF but applied to SBC-adjusted yield
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Subtract |annualSBC| when building the 'fcf-yield' bucket in gatherBySubProfile so write and read sites use the same definition

top_fixes.title: Universe-shrink deletions only per-ticker INFO, no aggregate survivor-bias alarm
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Aggregate counts of skipped-mcap + fx-unknown + price-only-floor deletions; emit a HIGH alert when the deletion ratio exceeds a baseline (>5% of universe or >2x prior run)

top_fixes.title: Field-coverage drift blinded ~7d by price-only persistence of stale fundamentals
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Tag coverage-history entries with pullMode and compute drift coverage only over snapshots freshly fundamentals-pulled this run (status 'ok'), or keep a separate fresh-fundamentals coverage series

top_fixes.title: Scalar KEY_FIELDS use `.value != null`, diverging from grader's finite test
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Export _hasMetric from methods/data-quality.js and reuse it for scalar KEY_FIELDS so report and grader share one definition of presence

top_fixes.title: DST window misclassifies early-Mar/late-Nov -> same-day look-ahead
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Compute the actual DST transition (2nd Sun Mar / 1st Sun Nov), or just always use the conservative 21:00 UTC close threshold

top_fixes.title: horizonActualDays exposed but never used; summary pools 79-84d windows
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Rescale per-vintage return by horizonNominalDays/horizonActualDays before aggregating, or drop vintages with |actual-nominal|>3d from the summary

top_fixes.title: Entry backward-snap books untradable weekend/holiday gap
top_fixes.suggested_fix: For the ENTRY date snap forward to the next available trading day while keeping EXIT backward-snap; document the asymmetry

top_fixes.title: Survivor bias: zero-eval early vintages + unstable universe size
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Persist delisted-ticker final (last-traded) prices so dropped names contribute realized returns; report universe-size per vintage and gate when it deviates >X% from the median

top_fixes.title: Early vintages lack score; pick membership determined differently
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Backfill score for legacy vintages or tag with scoreSource; have walk-forward/method-effectiveness exclude or separately bucket vintages with scoreSource!=='score'

top_fixes.title: Vintage date gaps silently shorten coverage
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Emit a coverage diagnostic (expected business days vs present vintages) in walk-forward.json; warn when >X% of expected vintages are missing

top_fixes.title: Backtest scripts share output file with different schemas
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Give the two scripts distinct output filenames; ensure the _bias block is always present; consider deleting backtest-from-history.js

top_fixes.title: Benchmark availability-ordered, not strategy-matched
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Map each mode to a fixed style-appropriate benchmark (growth->QQQ/IWO, turnaround->IWM); record benchmarkTicker per vintage and refuse to aggregate across differing benchmarks

top_fixes.title: topAllMust(...,9999).length sorts entire set only to count
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Replace topAllMust(...,9999).length with a plain filter().length (no sort); cache modeEvals[modeId].score into a local before sorting

top_fixes.title: discoveryRows DataGuard filter walks Object.entries(results) per row
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Precompute MT.dataGuardIds once, then per row iterate only that small list (r.results[mid]) instead of Object.entries + per-method isDataGuard

top_fixes.title: Snapshot load uses serial blocking readFileSync loop
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Mirror the loadStocks() batched fs.promises.readFile pattern (CONCURRENCY=32) from generate-modes-report.js for the snapshot read in evaluateAllStocks

top_fixes.title: classifySubProfile re-run M times per evaluateStock (no memo)
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Memoize classifySubProfile on stock (stock.__sp) for the duration of one evaluateStock or pass the sub-profile into effectiveThreshold; hoist _dataAsOfFromStock/_dataAgeDays to once-per-stock

top_fixes.title: Health-check allowlist misses generate-screener; deploys stale HTML + 404 detail
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Add generate-screener (and generate-diff-report, detect-changes, snapshot-r40rx-history) to EXPECTED_SCRIPTS; in Deploy hard-fail on stale screener.html timestamp or missing screener-detail.json

top_fixes.title: detect-changes soft-fail leaves alert/trend state stale, no health coverage
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Have detect-changes.js emit a pipeline-health report and add it to EXPECTED_SCRIPTS, or add an alert-state freshness probe (fail if lastRun != RUN_DATE_UTC)

top_fixes.title: fetchScreener off-by-one: 'retry 3x' but backs off twice
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Allow retry on the last attempt too (or fix the comment to 'up to 2 retries'); add a warn distinguishing 429-exhausted from other failures

top_fixes.title: Quarterly series order assumed with no date-based guard
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Sort each quarterly array by the rows' period/endDate descending explicitly instead of trusting array order; assert/log if incoming order disagreed

top_fixes.title: Watchlist rewritten with fresh timestamp even on Yahoo-side blackout
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Track contribution counts per source class; if Yahoo screener+exchange contribution is zero/below floor while discovery succeeded, emit ::warning:: or exit non-zero

top_fixes.title: Raw ticker+'.json' bypasses safeSnapshotFilename
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Route both write and read through safeSnapshotFilename() from lib/snapshot-fs.js in snapshot-score-history.js, snapshot-r40rx-history.js, and the readers in generate-screener.js

top_fixes.title: _n_<metric> reports full array length not filtered subset
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Report _n_<mid> as useArr.length (the array actually used), or add a separate _nUsed_<mid> field and gate lookupPercentile/minN on it

top_fixes.title: roce medians computed/written but consumed by no method
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Drop roce from the gather/compute path until needed, or wire a roce-based sector-relative method mirroring sector-relative-roic

top_fixes.title: Degraded mode ranks 90 (not 75) for roic in [p50, 1.5*p50)
top_fixes.suggested_fix: In degraded mode cap rank at 75 for roic>=p50, or skip the p75 buckets entirely when degraded

top_fixes.title: Coverage tracker omits ~10 consumed metrics
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Add the consumed fields to TRACKED_FIELDS (at minimum targetMeanPrice.value, returnOnEquity.value, enterpriseToEbitda.value, meta.sharesOutstanding)

top_fixes.title: Large-scale FX fallback has no run-level alarm threshold
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Count snapshots/currencies on hardcoded-fallback per run; emit a HIGH alert when the fallback ratio exceeds a threshold

top_fixes.title: Dead _convertToUSD helper fails open on unknown currency
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Delete the unused _convertToUSD helper, or return a sentinel on missing rate so it cannot fail open

top_fixes.title: Transaction costs/spread/slippage/FX ignored across backtest stack
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Document the gross-return assumption prominently; for cross-currency picks convert to USD before benchmark comparison or restrict benchmark/universe alpha to same-currency cohorts

top_fixes.title: Short-history stocks mislabeled by lookback year + duplicate fetches
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Reject/relabel a series whose first date isn't within ~30d of period1; compute per-pick returns once and reuse for the median

top_fixes.title: methodSummary lazy-init branch per row*method pair
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Pre-initialize _methodCounts[m.id]={computable:0,passing:0} once before the rows loop; inner loop becomes a plain increment

top_fixes.title: Snapshot header read twice (sortByStaleness + _getExistingSnapshotAge)
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Drop existsSync (rely on openSync ENOENT, already caught); stash parsed asOf age in a Map keyed by ticker and reuse in _getExistingSnapshotAge

top_fixes.title: sector-medians CLI loads snapshots with serial readFileSync loop
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Reuse the batched fs.promises.readFile loader (CONCURRENCY 32) used by generate-modes-report.js loadStocks; make the CLI block async

top_fixes.title: dedupeByCompany norm() runs ~5 full-string regex scans per name
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Combine the accent-class replaces into one map-based pass or String.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,''); fast-path pure-ASCII names

top_fixes.title: Stale operational docs in live gates (18% vs 13%, 180 vs 240 min)
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Fix the warning string to 13%; update the monthly-sec-xbrl comment to state serialization relies on the shared concurrency group, not the schedule gap

top_fixes.title: Watchlist sanity floor of 200 is 0.8% of universe
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Relative gate: fail if size < max(10000, 0.6 * previous committed watchlist size), reading previous size from git HEAD before the refresh overwrites it

top_fixes.title: Daily cron runs 7 days/week incl weekends/holidays; congested slot
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Use '17 2 * * 2-6' (Tue-Sat UTC = Mon-Fri US trading days, off-peak minute); optionally short-circuit on market holidays

top_fixes.title: Actions pinned to mutable major tags (@v4) not commit SHAs
top_fixes.suggested_fix: Pin actions/checkout and actions/setup-node to full commit SHAs with a tag comment and let Dependabot bump them
